summary: Russia launched a massive combined drone and missile attack across Ukraine on 13.11.2026, targeting at least 14 regions with Shahed/Geran-5 UAVs, reactive drones, and Banderyol cruise missiles. points: Ukrainian drones struck Volgograd oil refinery on November 11 causing a massive fire, and also hit the LVDS "Samara" facility and military depots in Rostov region, marking at least the 13th attack on the Lukoil refinery complex. (Source: @UkraineNow/85272, @eRadarrua/130465)

President Zelensky met with US envoys Witkoff and Kushner at Casement airbase in Ireland, reporting progress on a major prisoner exchange and claiming Putin agreed to European involvement in peace negotiations. (Source: @UkraineNow/85270, @UkraineNow/85271)

Zelensky publicly criticized systematic Starshield restrictions along the entire front line, stating they help Russians kill more Ukrainians and deliver more accurate strikes, and is seeking clarification from the US. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23996, @UkraineNow/85258)
Finland allocated €37.3 million to support Ukraine's defense sector and reconstruction, aiming to engage Finnish businesses in critical infrastructure rebuilding. (Source: @UkraineNow/85275)
